title: The live cohort changes while being evaluated
detail: Opening: 62 IDs/30 unprefixed names. Closing: 61 IDs/29 unprefixed, AirLock becomes a dependency and seven pause names become zz-inc. MobileMcp is not resolved. Refreshed VibeKanban, AgsLag and SessionLedger headers still say pause.
impact: Names and mutable counts cannot be a stable work queue or permission source.
next_action: Preserve the 62-ID cohort; reconcile explicit decisions for the nine observation changes. Publish separate active, dependency, incubation, paused/reference and unresolved sets.

title: AgilePlus does not enforce its advertised all-language 85% coverage
detail: The inspected workflow enforces Rust line coverage at 20%, enforces Python at 85%, prints Go coverage without a fail floor, and echoes the aggregate claim. These are configured controls, not measured coverage results.
impact: Successful workflow completion can overstate the accepted assurance contract. The inspected workflow also does not establish independent unit/integration/E2E metrics.
next_action: Use approved denominator inventories, isolated suite measurements and real aggregate evaluation; seed below-threshold, missing and wrong-revision records and prove nonzero failure.

title: The documentation-health replacement is still a success-returning scaffold
detail: docs-health counts Markdown files but leaves Vale, markdownlint and link detection TODO, emits empty findings and returns Ok. Its smoke test is empty.
impact: A consolidated tool can preserve or reintroduce the original false-green behavior; wrappers must not certify unexecuted checks.
next_action: Implement or adapt real native checks; fail on missing required tools, traversal errors and broken fixtures; prove hosted failure propagation.

title: Consolidation left active consumers pointing at inaccessible source locations
detail: PhenoFabric fetches a manifest crate from KooshaPari/nanovms; that name and ID 1199379049 are unavailable here. HeliosLab depends on clap-ext, whose old URL also returns 404, plus an old observability location.
impact: A cache-warm developer build may succeed while a clean checkout cannot resolve its dependencies. This audit has not executed a clean build or proved deletion.
next_action: Verify source/API-equivalent successors and immutable dependency identity; perform cache-isolated fetch/build/consumer tests before retiring any old location.

title: Multiple repositories still expose overlapping source ownership
detail: ShareCLI core lib.rs has identical Git blob cb35ab8d... in PhenoTooling and sharecli. PhenoTooling registers absorbed ShareCLI crates. PhenoAI registers Eidolon crates while Eidolon remains active.
impact: A deliberate mirror is possible, but a missing single-writer/release policy permits divergent fixes and reintroduces the duplication consolidation was intended to remove.
next_action: Decide source owner, distribution/mirror contract, consumer pins and integration lead per capability; do not delete a copy solely because one file matches.

title: Published release metadata is ahead of actual downloadable product evidence
detail: AgilePlus latest release Installers + green tests has no attached assets. Forgecode latest September 15 release has no assets. Jcode fork latest release returns only a FreeBSD x86_64 archive.
impact: Tags and release descriptions are not proof that the user can install the tested fork or desktop product on Mac/Windows. Other package channels were not exhaustively inspected.
next_action: Resolve the actual distribution channel; bind source, build, signed artifact, install, update and run receipts. Qualify Mac/Windows channels actually used by the operator.

title: Civis improved state persistence but the player build is still weakly specified
detail: Commit 264359af adds populated archive round-trip cases and mirrors cultural/ideological/aggression/unrest state. The Mac script still builds a minimal Bevy feature set and permits absent assets. Latest stable is September 5 CLI archives.
impact: Substantive world correctness work is real; it does not establish game-first presentation, continuity or a qualified installed .app.
next_action: Define required presentation/assets, build the real player artifact, and run create/play/intervene/save/quit/reopen plus bounded unattended continuation. Preserve subsystem determinism tests without globalizing them.

title: Forgecode integration did advance
detail: Promotion PR #277, previously open in the September 11 audit, merged into main September 12 at 10:02:14 UTC. Current release has a newer tag but no attached binaries.
impact: This is verified integration progress, not evidence of a stalled worker. Installed artifact and current behavior remain separate questions.
next_action: Test the actual current executable for session/search/readonly boundaries and streaming; publish and identify the same candidate, rather than reopening completed promotion work.

title: Product identity still drifts away from the accepted intent
detail: Tracera is advertised as audit/observability rather than the canonical product graph. HeliosLab root/manifest describe mixed workbench/config identities. helios-cli excludes its vendored Codex implementation from the root workspace. Pine mixes 70% and 25%.
impact: Agents can pass a build for the wrong product surface or write more documentation for a changed goal without a decision.
next_action: Name one current target and its public entrypoint; bind the exact acceptance journey and build profile. Preserve future intent without claiming it is shipped.

title: PhenoAI minimum-toolchain claim conflicts with its resolver
detail: The workspace selects resolver 3 while advertising rust-version 1.75. Official Cargo documentation requires Rust 1.84 or newer for resolver 3.
impact: The manifest cannot establish a coherent old-toolchain build promise. Native compatibility was not tested here.
next_action: Choose and test the accepted minimum toolchain, member inheritance and lockfile behavior; fix the contract and implementation together.

title: Retained dependencies and paused repositories retain destructive or stale instructions
detail: AgentApiPlusPlus says both do not delete/merge and deprecated/will delete. Parpoura mixes pause, migration and deletion. Some current incubation-like names retain explicit no-work text.
impact: Workers can select whichever paragraph supports an action. A header or rename is not an authenticated decision record.
next_action: Record latest scoped human decisions and supersession pointers in existing authority; constrain credentials separately; do not resume mass deletions or mass unpausing.

title: A smaller count is not yet a proven simpler dependency graph
detail: The current 62-ID portfolio has fewer repository homes, but PhenoTooling now bundles broad subsystems, PhenoAI absorbs device code, and old dependency locations persist.
impact: Context width may have moved into wider workspaces and ambiguous package ownership instead of actually shrinking semantic change cost.
next_action: Measure affected packages, duplicate implementations, dependency cycles, context/file footprint per change and clean consumer build time. Use package/applet boundaries before another repo-count target.

title: Some products have honest role-specific exceptions
detail: CivicSurvival-public explicitly omits private generators/server and is not a third-party buildable snapshot. Eidolon distinguishes unsupported/default paths and an unshipped REST daemon. WorldSphereMod distinguishes CODE_LANDED and PROVEN.
impact: These boundaries should be retained, not erased to force a universal green score or artificial .app deliverable.
next_action: Qualify the actual distributed mod, native driver or selected game profile, and explicitly model inaccessible producer evidence.

title: Documentation/landing/observability migration needs a consumer proof, not another registry
detail: The current roster and source references do not by themselves demonstrate where the former PhenoDocs renderer, landing publication, journey verifier and retired framework dependencies are actually built and used.
impact: Renaming or copying a tooling package is not evidence of documentation deployment, private/public safety or preserved integration behavior.
next_action: Identify existing canonical tool packages and content consumers, keep AgilePlus repo-scoped, and demonstrate one real docs/landing/app route with revision-linked product media. No new registry is required.
